title: Cancel Your Plan
html:
Cancelling takes one press and you keep your plan to the end of the period you paid for.

Steps

  1. Open Billing And Credits and then Your Plan.
  2. Press Cancel My Plan.
  3. Read what happens, then press Cancel My Plan again to confirm. Press Go Back to keep it.

The Email We Send

The moment your plan is cancelled we email you the date it ends. A monthly plan ends at the end of the period you paid for and an annual plan at the end of the current month. The email for an annual plan also says that the whole months you have not used are refunded within a day after the plan ends and that we email you when the refund is made. It comes whether you cancelled here or in the customer area. Pressing Keep My Plan sends nothing. If you cancel again after keeping your plan we email you again.

Monthly Plans

You keep your plan until the end of the period you have paid for. Nothing more is charged. After that your account carries on without a plan.

Annual Plans

Your plan ends at the end of the current month of your year. Each whole month left after it is refunded to the card you paid with, one-twelfth of what you paid for the plan for each month. The confirmation shows the months and the amount before you confirm. The refund goes in the next daily run after the plan ends.

Moving To A Lower Plan

Cancel here, then buy the lower plan on the pricing page once this one ends. You can buy it only after the plan has ended.

Your bots pause between the two plans and your bot pages show as unavailable, so buy it straight away. We email you reminders before your plan ends and again the moment it has ended. Your bots come back as soon as the new plan starts, oldest first, up to its bot limit.

Use the same email address as your account. If you are a founder, press Open The Customer Area on the Billing page first so you are signed in to your billing account. The checkout then applies your founders coupon by itself.

Changed Your Mind?

Until the plan ends, Your Plan shows Ends and a date, with a Keep My Plan button. Press it and your plan carries on and renews as before.

Cancelling In The Customer Area

The customer area has its own Cancel button, which counts the same as Cancel My Plan. You keep your plan to the same date, an annual plan refunds its whole months left in the same way and we send you the same reminders. It cancels with our payment processor at once, so Your Plan shows Ends and the date with no Keep My Plan button. To carry on, buy a plan again once it ends.

If A Payment Does Not Go Through

You keep your plan while a renewal payment is retried, so update your card in the customer area in that time. If the retries end and the payment still has not gone through, your plan ends then. It never carries on into the period that payment was for, even if the plan is cancelled afterwards. This holds where you pressed Cancel My Plan while the payment was retried too.

A plan cancelled in the customer area before its renewal payment has gone through ends at once, at the end of the last period you paid for. If that payment still goes through before the next daily billing run, your plan comes back until the end of the period it paid for. A payment after that run gives you no plan, so contact the Botter Support Team and they refund it.

After Your Plan Ends

  • Your account stays open. You can still sign in and chat on bots you bought access to.
  • Your bots are paused until you choose a plan again. Their data is kept.
  • Unused included credits are reset. Remaining credits from any Botter Booster Packs you bought are untouched.
  • Auto top-up switches off.
  • When you buy a plan again your bots come back, oldest first, up to its bot limit. If it allows fewer bots than you have, we email you the limit and the number still paused.

To close your account completely, see Close Your Account.
